description: Pinned license checker used by CI
//security_rationale: license-checker-rseidelsohn@5.0.1 replaces the unmaintained license-checker@25.0.1 chain through read-installed@4, glob@7 and vulnerable minimatch@3. GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 affects every minimatch version below 11.0.1. The replacement still declares parents on minimatch 10 and glob 13; the tool-local overrides force minimatch >=11.0.3 and glob >=14.0.3 (the latter also closes GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4). In a disposable install, the replacement returned byte-identical media production CSV and matched the old checker's positive and negative allowlist outcomes. The major-range skews are recorded in .override-range-baseline.json; revisit when upstream declares compatible patched majors. Preserve the workflow allowlist and NOTICE attribution checks.
